name: glossa
description: Managed MCP relay for explicitly exposed local coding workspaces.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build --workspace @glossa/protocol && npm run build --workspace @ariobarin/glossa && npm run build --workspace @glossa/relay
scripts.check: npm run docs:check && npm run site:check && npm run review:check && npm run build && npm test
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @glossa/protocol && npm run dev --workspace @glossa/relay
scripts.cli:hud-demo: npm run build --workspace @glossa/protocol && npm run hud:demo --workspace @ariobarin/glossa
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @glossa/relay && npm run test --workspace @ariobarin/glossa
scripts.review:check: npm run review:metadata:check && node scripts/check-review-readiness.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/check-restricted-data-corpus.ts
scripts.review:check:submission: npm run check && npm run review:check:production && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run review:check:plugin && npm pack --workspace @ariobarin/glossa --dry-run && git diff --check
